newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror to pay some directors with shares.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror to pay some directors with shares.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said in its proxy statement it planned to change its method for compensating non-employee directors, switching to a stock-based plan from a fixed pay system.
Under a new plan effective Jan. 1, each non-employee Times Mirror director would get an annual retainer of 500 shares of Series A common stock, the company said.
Each would also receive a cash payment equal to the value of 500 shares of such stock, based on its prevailing market price, the company said.

If the plan was approved by shareholders, Times Mirror said non-employee directors would also annually receive an options grant for 5,000 shares of its Series A common stock. The plan also suspended a pension plan for directors and eliminated board and committee meeting fees, it said.
